evidence.observation: Reboiler reads 437-440 °C, physically implausible versus the 70 °C column profile and slowly drifting upward — sensor fault likely
Profile flat and steady at ~70 °C bottom/mid and ~63.3 °C top for 20 min; little separation development
Reflux 0.1-0.3 L/h and distillate 0.1-1.0 L/h, near sensor noise floor; FYI702 ~6.8 inconsistent with those raw flows
Pressure drops steady (0.6/3.0 mbar), system pressure stable ~500 mbar — no flooding or blockage

args.missing_evidence: An independent reboiler temperature reading (or bath/heater setpoint) to confirm T701 is a faulty channel, plus a distillate composition (GC) sample to test separation
